admission.justification: Without the gate at this commit a leaf's memory is committed, and can then land, while worklist items are open: a changed invariant with no row, or a changed file with no onboarding trace, reaches the parent line as stale knowledge.

applicability: Every converted-memory leaf closeout, its preview, and a resumed closeout or recorded landing that rejudges one.
conditions: The memory tree is the exact judged tree with the history closing applied.
The candidate verdict reads the code candidate tree and the memory worktree's tree by their ids.
exclusions: Unconverted memory, which refuses before this gate (MIK-R46).
A series closeout, which delegates to its series owner.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_knowledge_reopen.py::test_the_public_closeout_refuses_an_open_item_and_commits_once_it_is_answered; mcp/tests/test_knowledge_reopen.py::test_a_recovered_closeout_is_gated_like_a_fresh_one; mcp/tests/test_knowledge_reopen.py::test_a_leaf_that_continues_after_its_closeout_writes_its_next_attempt; MIK-R09 rules 3 and 5; developer direction D34

statement: On converted memory the worktree closeout commits or records a leaf's memory only after the knowledge validator and the mandatory invariant gate have passed over the closeout's verified code commit and the exact memory tree, with the history closing applied: the tree it is about to commit, the HEAD commit it records when nothing is left to commit, and the memory commit a resumed closeout recovers. An open worklist item, an incomplete run or a validator failure refuses and names every finding: no memory is committed, the contract records no closeout, and unchanged owned history/ignore preparations are restored while concurrent content is preserved and named. The candidate verdict the preview and the apply's preflight both read asks the gate over the candidate, and on converted memory it also asks every refusal the memory refresh reaches from the code candidate tree and the memory worktree's tree alone, so a leaf that deletes a file an entity row cites is refused before the approval is claimed and before the code commit, with both sides uncommitted. The closeout commits the code before the memory, so a refusal at the memory commit leaves the code commit made; a rerun takes that commit as it is and completes once the gate passes. Leaf integration rejudges its closeout pair through the leaf validator and recomputed worklist before moving refs. Recorded leaf landing rejudges supplied landed memory with the recorded closeout code when the landed code equals or descends from it, otherwise the landed code, against the recorded memory base before recording.
